statements.impact_statement: minimatch is a development dependency only (eslint, @eslint/config-array, typescript-eslint, eslint-plugin-import-x and @vscode/vsce require ^10) and is not in the published .vsix, which ships no dependencies. In development, the only glob patterns it matches are this repository's own lint and packaging configuration.

katex is a development dependency only (eslint-config-phun-ky > @eslint/markdown > micromark-extension-math > katex) and is not in the published .vsix, which ships no dependencies. In development, ESLint loads katex but never calls it: lint parses Markdown and never renders math to HTML.
